Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan will think they are a few short after the platform they had yesterday. Misbah was out for 96 today and despite the fifty from Sarfraz they could not accelerate as they would have liked. West Indies will want to make the most of the good batting conditions. Let's see how they go.

West Indies were much better as they managed to take the remaining six wickets for just 148 runs. Gabriel was the star for them with his maiden five-wicket haul. Holder too gave him good support with three wickets towards the end. Gabriel finished with his career best figures - 5 for 96.

That ends a fine effort from Pakistan in their first innings. They were jolted early as both their openers departed cheaply yesterday. Asad Shafiq scored a quick fifty but was bowled on 68. The veterans in Younis Khan and Misbah-ul-Haq combined to put up a 175-run stand and kept Pakistan ahead. Younis though fell on 127 at the stroke of stumps on the first day.

Hello everyone and a very warm welcome to the coverage of Day 2 of the second Test between Pakistan and West Indies from the Sheikh Zayed Stadium, Abu Dhabi. Pakistan are again on top, thanks to a brilliant 175-run stand between Younis Khan and Misbah-ul-Haq. The former departed on 127 on what turned out to be the final ball of the day but the home side will hope the skipper will lead from the front and ensure they get a huge score on board.
...DAY 2....SESSION 1....

West Indies were far too inconsistent again and ineffective. A non-innovative and laid back captain is not helping them either. They have plenty of work left to be done and they will need wickets early tomorrow to get back in this game. The home side is not going to repeat the mistakes they committed in the previous Test and would look to score quickly to give their bowlers enough runs to play with. Do join us for all the action from Day 2. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Shannon Gabriel was the pick of the bowlers for the visitors. He bowled his heart out but had a catch dropped off him when Misbah was on 54. Younis too was dropped on 83 and he made them pay by registering a fine ton. He was in complete control till he got out just at the stroke of stumps on 127. Despite that wicket, Pakistan are still on top and with a lot of batting left they will back themselves to accelerate tomorrow and notch up a huge score.

End of an eventful day of Test cricket! Pakistan end the day right on top thanks to a brilliant 175-run stand between Younis Khan and Misbah-ul-Haq! They were jolted early in the day, when both their openers departed cheaply but Shafiq kept them in the game with a brisk fifty. Misbah and Younis then combined to keep the Windies at bay. They were cautious at first but never let the spinners settle. Both Chase and Bishoo were hit all over the park as West Indies wilted under pressure.

Welcome back for the final session of play. MISBAH-UL-HAQ and YOUNIS KHAN are out to bat. The umpires are checking the ball with the 8-guage. The umpire is not happy with it and they have asked for a change of ball. MIGUEL CUMMINS to begin the final session of the day.
....DAY 1...SESSION 3....

West Indies were testing but only in patches and the uninspiring captaincy of Jason Holder does leave a lot to be desired. They did try to stop the flow of runs but there were far too many boundary balls on offer which did not help their cause further. Younis was dropped by Brathwaite on 83 just at the stroke of Tea, that could have been huge for them but it sums up how West Indies have been. Will things change for them in the final session? Do join us to find out.

That's a dominating session for Pakistan with 110 runs scored. They lost the wicket of Asad Shafiq to Shannon Gabriel early but both Younis and Misbah have stitched a strong stand and have been aggressive against spin in particular. The partnership is a vital one for the home side and Pakistan will want them to carry on the good work and build a platform for the rest to capitalize on. Younis is nearing a ton and will want to hit another big hundred.

Welcome back for the second session of play! ASAD SHAFIQ and YOUNIS KHAN stride out to bat for Pakistan. They will want to continue their good work and build on this platform. West Indies begin with MIGUEL CUMMINS! Here we go...

Younis Khan along with Shafiq has been superb and they have put up a good stand so far. The runs have come at a fair clip and the visitors will want to put a break on those. They will hope to put in a better performance in the session coming up else it could be a long, long day for them. Do join us at 1500 IST for the second session of play.

Overs 31, Runs 95, Wickets 2 - An even session of Test cricket for both teams! Pakistan won the toss and not surprisingly elected to bat. They lost their openers early but the new No. 3 for them in Asad Shafiq has played at a brisk rate to keep his team in the session. He's looked positive and untroubled as well. Game time! The players are out in the middle. Pakistan openers AZHAR ALI and SAMI ASLAM are out to bat. WEST INDIES begin the Test with SHANNON GABRIEL!

Jason Holder says even he wanted to bat first. It's a dry and fresh wicket than Dubai and batting first is always a good option. Further says they are familiar with the red ball and they will look to do the basics right this time around. Isn't happy with the mistakes they committed in the last game and will look to rectify it now. Adds they would like to win the crucial moments and that they have shown they can compete. Informs he always stresses on this very thing in the dressing room. Ends by saying they have made one forced change as Shane Dowrich is not fit and Shai Hope gets a game.

Misbah reckons that it is a dry wicket and hopes that the pitch will slow down going into third day when the second innings comes around. Adds that his team finds themselves a bit more comfortable with the red ball. With the pink ball, he reckons that they were not sure of how much it will swing. On his record of equaling Imran Khan, leading Pakistan in 48 Tests, says that he is honored and proud of leading Pakistan. Mentions that he is not after world records but is happy to contribute. Three changes for them - Babar Azam  is out for Younis Khan. Mohammad Amir and Wahab Riaz have been rested for Rahat Ali and Zulfiqar Babar.
TOSS - PAKISTAN WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT! When asked about what Misbah wanted to do after winning the toss, the Pakistan skipper actually asked Ian Bishop jokingly about what he should do.

PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan doing the pitch report reckons that it is a batting paradise as expected. In the last Test here, Shoaib Malik, Alastair Cook scored a double hundred and an average score of 394 in first innings tells you it is a good wicket to bat on. There is a grass near the landing area for the bowlers but not so much across the wicket. Expect runs and plenty of them.

West Indies will hope that they continue their good fight and hope to make sure they do not repeat their mistakes. Once again it was their top order which came good for them and they will want more contributions from them.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the first day of the second Test between Pakistan and West Indies. The hosts were clinical for the first three days before a usual Pakistan collapse made things tougher for them. The visitors led by Darren Bravo put up a fight but Yasir Shah and co. bowled well as a team to ensure they emerged victorious and take a 1-0 lead in the 3-match series. Let's see how things go in this Test.
